soc3.description: Indicates whether the application provider undergoes a Service Organization Control (SOC) three audit report.

sox.description: Indicates whether the application complies with the Sarbanes–Oxley Act (SOX) financial reporting requirements.

sp800_53.description: Indicates whether the application aligns with National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Special Publication 800-53 security and privacy controls.

ssae16.description: Indicates whether the application adheres to Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) No. 16.

ustr.description: Indicates whether the application complies with U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) data and trade protection requirements.

consumerPopularity.description: Indicates the relative popularity or adoption of the application based on the user or tenant usage metrics.

domainRegistrationDate.description: Specifies the date when the application's primary domain was registered, used to assess domain maturity and legitimacy.

founded.description: Year the company or organization behind the application was founded.

hasDisasterRecoveryPlan.description: Indicates whether the application provider maintains a disaster recovery or business continuity plan.

hostingCompanyName.description: Specifies the name of the company or provider that hosts the application's infrastructure.

location.description: Provides the geographical and operational location information for the application, including data center and headquarters regions.

privacyPolicy.description: Specifies the URL of the application's privacy policy.

termsOfService.description: Specifies the URL of the application's terms of service.

hasDataOwnership.description: Indicates whether customers maintain ownership and control of their data processed or stored by the application.

hasDmca.description: Indicates whether the application or organization complies with the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA) or equivalent copyright protection frameworks.

domainToCheck.description: Specifies the domain or hostname evaluated during the security assessment.

hasAdminAuditTrail.description: Indicates whether the application maintains an audit trail for administrative actions.

hasAnonymousUsage.description: Indicates whether the application allows anonymous or unauthenticated usage.

hasDataAuditTrail.description: Indicates whether the application logs access or modification of customer data for audit purposes.

hasDataClassification.description: Indicates whether the application classifies and labels data based on sensitivity levels.

hasDataEncrypted.description: Indicates whether data at rest and in transit are encrypted using approved algorithms.

hasEnforceTransportEnc.description: Indicates whether HTTPS or equivalent secure transport is enforced for all communication channels.

hasIpRestriction.description: Indicates whether access to the application can be restricted based on IP address or network range.

hasMFA.description: Indicates whether the application supports or enforces multi-factor authentication (MFA).

hasPenTest.description: Indicates whether the application undergoes periodic penetration testing or external security reviews.

hasRememberPassword.description: Indicates whether the application supports password-saving functionality, which may pose a security risk.

hasSamlSupport.description: Indicates whether the application supports SAML-based single sign-on (SSO).

hasUserAuditLogs.description: Indicates whether user activity is logged for security or compliance monitoring.

hasUserDataUpload.description: Indicates whether users can upload or store personal or organizational data within the application.

hasUserRolesSupport.description: Indicates whether the application supports role-based access control (RBAC).

hasValidCertName.description: Indicates whether the certificate’s common name matches the application’s verified domain.

httpsSecurityHeaders.description: Lists the HTTP security headers detected for the application (for example, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, or CSP).

isCertTrusted.description: Indicates whether the application’s certificate is signed by a trusted certificate authority (CA).

isDrownVulnerable.description: Indicates whether the application is vulnerable to the DROWN (Decrypting RSA with Obsolete and Weakened eNcryption) attack.

isHeartbleedProof.description: Indicates whether the application’s SSL implementation is protected from the Heartbleed vulnerability.

lastBreachDate.description: Specifies the date of the last publicly reported data breach or security incident related to the application, if known.

isSignUpAllowed.description: Optional. Specifies whether the authentication flow includes an option to sign up (create account) and sign in. Default value is false meaning only sign in is enabled.

configuration.description: Configuration that overrides the default settings from the referenced custom extension, such as timeout and retry values. Optional.

migrationPropertyId.description: The name of the custom extension attribute that indicates whether a user requires migration. This property must reference a valid custom attribute on the user object (for example, extension<appId>requiresMigration). Required.

userTypeToCreate.description: The type of user to create. Maps to userType property of user object. The possible values are: member, guest, unknownFutureValue.

configuration.description: Configuration that overrides the default settings from the referenced custom extension, such as timeout and retry values. Optional.

attestationObject.description: A CBOR-encoded attestation object containing the authenticator data and attestation statement. This value is Base64URL-encoded without padding.

clientDataJSON.description: Contains the JSON-compatible serialization of client data passed to the authenticator by the client. This value is Base64URL-encoded without padding.

excludeTarget.description: A single entity that is excluded from this feature.

includeTarget.description: A single entity that is included in this feature.

state.description: Enable or disable the feature. The possible values are: default, enabled, disabled, unknownFutureValue. The default value is used when the configuration hasn't been explicitly set and uses the default behavior of Microsoft Entra ID for the setting. The default value is disabled.

identifier.description: The identifier of the X.509 certificate. Required.

x509CertificateAuthenticationMode.description: The type of strong authentication mode. The possible values are: x509CertificateSingleFactor, x509CertificateMultiFactor, unknownFutureValue. Required.

x509CertificateRuleType.description: The type of the X.509 certificate mode configuration rule. The possible values are: issuerSubject, policyOID, unknownFutureValue. Required.

id.description: The ID of the entity targeted.

excludeTargets.description: Users and groups of users that are excluded from being prompted to set up the authentication method.

includeTargets.description: Users and groups of users that are prompted to set up the authentication method.

snoozeDurationInDays.description: Specifies the number of days that the user sees a prompt again if they select 'Not now' and snoozes the prompt. Minimum: 0 days. Maximum: 14 days. If the value is '0', the user is prompted during every MFA attempt.

htmlStrings.description: A key-value map where keys are string identifiers and values are rich text with HTML format. SharePoint servers treat the values as HTML content and run services like safety checks, search index and link fixup on them.

imageSources.description: A key-value map where keys are string identifiers and values are image sources. SharePoint servers treat the values as image sources and run services like search index and link fixup on them.

links.description: A key-value map where keys are string identifiers and values are links. SharePoint servers treat the values as links and run services like link fixup on them.

searchablePlainTexts.description: A key-value map where keys are string identifiers and values are strings that should be search indexed.

coverImageItemId.description: Unique identifier of the driveItem that is the cover of the album.

crc32Hash.description: The CRC32 value of the file (if available). Read-only.

quickXorHash.description: A proprietary hash of the file that can be used to determine if the contents of the file change (if available). Read-only.

sha1Hash.description: SHA1 hash for the contents of the file (if available). Read-only.

sha256Hash.description: This property isn't supported. Don't use.

sortBy.description: The method by which the folder should be sorted.

sortOrder.description: If true, indicates that items should be sorted in descending order. Otherwise, items should be sorted ascending.

viewType.description: The type of view that should be used to represent the folder.

queuedDateTime.description: Date and time the pending binary operation was queued in UTC time. Read-only.

customerId.description: The ID of the bookingCustomer for this appointment. If no ID is specified when an appointment is created, then a new bookingCustomer object is created. Once set, you should consider the customerId immutable.

customQuestionAnswers.description: It consists of the list of custom questions and answers given by the customer as part of the appointment

emailAddress.description: The SMTP address of the bookingCustomer who is booking the appointment

location.description: Represents location information for the bookingCustomer who is booking the appointment.

name.description: The customer's name.

notes.description: Notes from the customer associated with this appointment. You can get the value only when reading this bookingAppointment by its ID. You can set this property only when initially creating an appointment with a new customer. After that point, the value is computed from the customer represented by the customerId.

timeZone.description: The time zone of the customer. For a list of possible values, see dateTimeTimeZone.

endTime.description: The time of the day when work stops. For example, 17:00:00.0000000.

startTime.description: The time of the day when work starts. For example, 08:00:00.0000000.

endDate.description: End date of the availability window.

startDate.description: Start date of the availability window.

businessHours.description: The hours of operation in a week. The business hours value is set to null if the availability type isn't customWeeklyHours.

blob.description: The media configuration blob generated by smart media agent.

preFetchMedia.description: The list of media to pre-fetch.

joinMeetingId.description: The ID used to join the meeting.

passcode.description: The passcode used to join the meeting. Optional.

token.description: The token used to join the call.

countriesAndRegions.description: List of countries and/or regions in two-letter format specified by ISO 3166-2. Required.

countryLookupMethod.description: Determines what method is used to decide which country the user is located in. Possible values are clientIpAddress(default) and authenticatorAppGps. Note: authenticatorAppGps is not yet supported in the Microsoft Cloud for US Government.

includeUnknownCountriesAndRegions.description: true if IP addresses that don't map to a country or region should be included in the named location. Optional. Default value is false.

ipRanges.description: List of IP address ranges in IPv4 CIDR format (for example, 1.2.3.4/32) or any allowable IPv6 format from IETF RFC5969. Required.

isTrusted.description: true if this location is explicitly trusted. Optional. Default value is false.

applications.description: Applications and user actions included in and excluded from the policy. Required.

authenticationFlows.description: Authentication flows included in the policy scope.

clientApplications.description: Client applications (service principals and workload identities) included in and excluded from the policy. Either users or clientApplications is required.

clientAppTypes.description: Client application types included in the policy. The possible values are: all, browser, mobileAppsAndDesktopClients, exchangeActiveSync, easSupported, other. Required.  The easUnsupported enumeration member will be deprecated in favor of exchangeActiveSync, which includes EAS supported and unsupported platforms.

insiderRiskLevels.description: Insider risk levels included in the policy. The possible values are: minor, moderate, elevated, unknownFutureValue.

locations.description: Locations included in and excluded from the policy.

platforms.description: Platforms included in and excluded from the policy.

servicePrincipalRiskLevels.description: Service principal risk levels included in the policy. The possible values are: low, medium, high, none, unknownFutureValue.

signInRiskLevels.description: Sign-in risk levels included in the policy. The possible values are: low, medium, high, hidden, none, unknownFutureValue. Required.

userRiskLevels.description: User risk levels included in the policy. The possible values are: low, medium, high, hidden, none, unknownFutureValue. Required.

users.description: Users, groups, and roles included in and excluded from the policy. Either users or clientApplications is required.

builtInControls.description: List of values of built-in controls required by the policy. Possible values: block, mfa, compliantDevice, domainJoinedDevice, approvedApplication, compliantApplication, passwordChange, unknownFutureValue, riskRemediation.  Use the Prefer: include-unknown-enum-members request header to get the following value in this evolvable enum: riskRemediation.

customAuthenticationFactors.description: List of custom controls IDs required by the policy. For more information, see Custom controls.

operator.description: Defines the relationship of the grant controls. Possible values: AND, OR.

termsOfUse.description: List of terms of use IDs required by the policy.

applicationEnforcedRestrictions.description: Session control to enforce application restrictions. Only Exchange Online and Sharepoint Online support this session control.

cloudAppSecurity.description: Session control to apply cloud app security.

disableResilienceDefaults.description: Session control that determines whether it is acceptable for Microsoft Entra ID to extend existing sessions based on information collected prior to an outage or not.

persistentBrowser.description: Session control to define whether to persist cookies or not. All apps should be selected for this session control to work correctly.

signInFrequency.description: Session control to enforce signin frequency.

policyApplies.description: Specifies whether the policy applies to the sign-in properties provided in the request body. If policyApplies is true, the policy applies to the sign-in based on the sign-in properties provided. If policyApplies is false, the policy doesn't apply to the sign-in based on the sign-in properties provided and the analysisReasons property is populated to show the reason for the policy not applying.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: When the workflow was last modified.

createdBy.description: The user who created the workflow.

lastModifiedBy.description: The unique identifier of the Microsoft Entra identity that last modified the workflow.

quarantinedDateTime.description: The date and time when the workflow was quarantined.

quarantineReason.description: The reason the workflow was quarantined.

quarantineConfiguration.description: The threshold configuration that automatically halts the workflow when its conditions are met.

versionNumber.description: The version of the workflow.Supports $filter(lt, le, gt, ge, eq, ne) and $orderby.

subject.description: The subject of the submission mail.

submissionDateTime.description: The reported date and time of this submission. The timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2024 is 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z.

campaignId.description: The identifier of the campaign that this Teams message is part of.

channelId.description: The channel ID associated with this Teams message.

deliveryAction.description: The delivery action of this Teams message. The possible values are: unknown, deliveredAsSpam, delivered, blocked, replaced, unknownFutureValue.

deliveryLocation.description: The delivery location of this Teams message. The possible values are: unknown, teams, quarantine, failed, unknownFutureValue.

files.description: The list of file entities that are attached to this Teams message.

groupId.description: The identifier of the team or group that this message is part of.

isExternal.description: Indicates whether the message is owned by the organization that reported the security detection alert.

isOwned.description: Indicates whether the message is owned by your organization.

lastModifiedDateTime.description: Date and time when the message was last edited. The Timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2014 is 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z.

messageDirection.description: The direction of the Teams message. The possible values are: unknown, inbound, outbound, intraorg, unknownFutureValue.

messageId.description: Message identifier unique within the thread.

owningTenantId.description: Tenant ID (GUID) of the owner of the message.

parentMessageId.description: Identifier of the message to which the current message is a reply; otherwise, it's the same as the messageId.

receivedDateTime.description: The received date of this message. The Timestamp type represents date and time information using ISO 8601 format and is always in UTC. For example, midnight UTC on Jan 1, 2014 is 2014-01-01T00:00:00Z.

recipients.description: The recipients of this Teams message.

senderFromAddress.description: The SMTP format address of the sender.

senderIP.description: The IP address of the sender.

sourceAppName.description: Source of the message; for example, desktop and mobile.

sourceId.description: The source ID of this Teams message.

subject.description: The subject of this Teams message.

suspiciousRecipients.description: The list of recipients who were detected as suspicious.

threadId.description: Identifier of the channel or chat that this message is part of.

threadType.description: The Teams message type. Supported values are: Chat, Topic, Space, and Meeting.

urls.description: The URLs contained in this Teams message.

compromiseIndicators.description: Represents indicators and its associated verdict that suggests whether an email is compromised.

detonationBehaviourDetails.description: Shows the exact events that took place during detonation, and problematic or benign observations that contain URLs, IPs, domains, and files that were found during detonation. This property is deprecated and still stop returning data in March 2026. Use the detonationBehaviourDetailsV2 property instead.

detonationBehaviourDetailsV2.description: Shows the exact events that took place during detonation, and problematic or benign observations that contain URLs, IPs, domains, and files that were found during detonation in a JSON format.

detonationObservables.description: All observables in the detonation tree.

detonationScreenshotUri.description: Show any screenshots that were captured during detonation. No screenshots are captured if the URL opens into a link that directly downloads a file. However, you see the downloaded file in the detonation chain.

detonationVerdictReason.description: The reason for the verdict of the detonation.

entityMetadata.description: Additional metadata about the entity in JSON format.

mitreTechniques.description: The attack techniques, as aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

staticAnalysis.description: The results of static analysis performed on the file or URL.

displayName.description: Unique string that defines the name for the file plan descriptor associated with a particular retention label.

days.description: Specifies the time period in days for which an item with the applied retention label will be retained for.

altitude.description: Altitude, given in meters above sea level

heading.description: Heading in degrees from true north

horizontalAccuracy.description: Accuracy of longitude and latitude in meters

lastCollectedDateTime.description: Time at which location was recorded, relative to UTC

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate of the device's location

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate of the device's location

speed.description: Speed the device is traveling in meters per second

daylightBias.description: The time offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) for daylight saving time. This value is in minutes.

dayOccurrence.description: Represents the nth occurrence of the day of week that the transition from daylight saving time to standard time occurs.

dayOfWeek.description: Represents the day of the week when the transition from daylight saving time to standard time.

month.description: Represents the month of the year when the transition from daylight saving time to standard time occurs.

time.description: Represents the time of day when the transition from daylight saving time to standard time occurs.

year.description: Represents how frequently in terms of years the change from daylight saving time to standard time occurs. For example, a value of 0 means every year.

scopes.description: Required. Nonempty list of delegated permission scope identifiers published by the resource application to inherit. Entries must be unique and must not include any globally blocked scopes.

excludeActors.description: Collection of custom security attribute exemptions. If an actor user or service principal has the custom security attribute defined in this section, they're exempted from the restriction.  This means that calls the user or service principal makes to create or update apps are exempt from this policy enforcement.

maxLifetime.description: String value that indicates the maximum lifetime for key expiration, defined as an ISO 8601 duration. For example, P4DT12H30M5S represents four days, 12 hours, 30 minutes, and five seconds. This property is required when restrictionType is set to asymmetricKeyLifetime.

restrictForAppsCreatedAfterDateTime.description: Specifies the date from which the policy restriction applies to newly created applications. For existing applications, the enforcement date can be retroactively applied.

restrictionType.description: The type of restriction being applied. Possible values are asymmetricKeyLifetime, and unknownFutureValue. Each value of restrictionType can be used only once per policy.

excludeActors.description: Collection of custom security attribute exemptions. If an actor user or service principal has the custom security attribute defined in this section, they're exempted from the restriction.  This means that calls the user or service principal makes to create or update apps are exempt from this policy enforcement.

maxLifetime.description: String value that indicates the maximum lifetime for password expiration, defined as an ISO 8601 duration. For example, P4DT12H30M5S represents four days, 12 hours, 30 minutes, and five seconds. This property is required when restrictionType is set to passwordLifetime.

restrictForAppsCreatedAfterDateTime.description: Specifies the date from which the policy restriction applies to newly created applications. For existing applications, the enforcement date can be retroactively applied.

restrictionType.description: The type of restriction being applied. The possible values are: passwordAddition, passwordLifetime, symmetricKeyAddition, symmetricKeyLifetime, customPasswordAddition, and unknownFutureValue. Each value of restrictionType can be used only once per policy.

excludeActors.description: Collection of custom security attribute exemptions. If an actor user or service principal has the custom security attribute defined in this section, they're exempted from the restriction.  This means that calls the user or service principal makes to create or update apps are exempt from this policy enforcement.

excludeAppsReceivingV2Tokens.description: If true, the restriction isn't enforced for applications that are configured to receive V2 tokens in Microsoft Entra ID; else, the restriction is enforced for those applications.

excludeSaml.description: If true, the restriction isn't enforced for SAML applications in Microsoft Entra ID; else, the restriction is enforced for those applications.

isStateSetByMicrosoft.description: If true, Microsoft sets the identifierUriRestriction state. If false, the tenant modifies the identifierUriRestriction state. Read-only.

restrictForAppsCreatedAfterDateTime.description: Specifies the date from which the policy restriction applies to newly created applications. For existing applications, the enforcement date can be retroactively applied.

query.description: Represents the query for who the recipients are. For example, /groups/{group id}/members for group members and /users/{user id} for a specific user.

queryRoot.description: In the scenario where reviewers need to be specified dynamically, indicates the relative source of the query. This property is only required if a relative query (that is, ./manager) is specified.

queryType.description: Indicates the type of query. Allowed value is MicrosoftGraph.

recommendationLookBackDuration.description: Optional. Indicates the time period of inactivity (with respect to the start date of the review instance) that recommendations will be configured from. The recommendation will be to deny if the user is inactive during the look-back duration. For reviews of groups and Microsoft Entra roles, any duration is accepted. For reviews of applications, 30 days is the maximum duration. If not specified, the duration is 30 days.

signInScope.description: Indicates whether inactivity is calculated based on the user's inactivity in the tenant or in the application. The possible values are tenant, application, unknownFutureValue. application is only relevant when the access review is a review of an assignment to an application.

dataCenter.description: Specifies the region or physical location where the application's primary data center is hosted.

headquarters.description: Specifies the city, country or region where the application's owning organization is headquartered.

hasRightToErasure.description: Indicates whether the application provides users with the ability to request deletion of their personal data (the right to be forgotten).

isReportingDataBreaches.description: Indicates whether the organization reports personal data breaches to authorities and affected users in accordance with GDPR requirements.

statementUrl.description: Specifies the URL of the application's GDPR or privacy compliance statement, outlining how user data is handled.

hasBadCommonName.description: Indicates whether the certificate's common name doesn't match the expected domain name.

hasInsecureSignature.description: Indicates whether the certificate uses a weak or insecure signature algorithm (for example, MD5 or SHA-1).

hasNoChainOfTrust.description: Indicates whether the certificate chain of trust is incomplete or invalid.

isDenylisted.description: Indicates whether the certificate is on a known denylist or associated with compromised issuers.

isHostnameMismatch.description: Indicates whether the certificate's hostname doesn't match the domain it was issued for.

isNotAfter.description: Indicates whether the certificate is expired and no longer valid.

isNotBefore.description: Indicates whether the certificate isn't yet valid based on its activation date.

isRevoked.description: Indicates whether the issuing certificate authority revoked the certificate.

isSelfSigned.description: Indicates whether the certificate is self-signed rather than issued by a trusted certificate authority.

appId.description: The identifier for an application corresponding to a condition which will trigger an authenticationEventListener.

views.description: A collection of displays of the attribute collection page.

clientConfiguration.description: Configuration regarding properties of the custom extension which can be overwritten per event listener. If no values are provided, the properties on the custom extension are used.

id.description: The ID of the entity that's targeted in the include or exclude rule, or all_users to target all users.

targetType.description: The kind of entity that's targeted. The possible values are: group, administrativeUnit, role, unknownFutureValue.

id.description: The object identifier of a Microsoft Entra user or group.

targetedAuthenticationMethod.description: The authentication method that the user is prompted to register. The value can be Fido2 or microsoftAuthenticator.

answer.description: The answer given by the user in case the answerInputType is text.

answerInputType.description: The expected answer type. The possible values are: text, radioButton, unknownFutureValue.

answerOptions.description: In case the answerInputType is radioButton, this will consists of a list of possible answer values.

isRequired.description: Indicates whether it is mandatory to answer the custom question.

questionId.description: The ID of the custom question.

selectedOptions.description: The answers selected by the user.

resourceId.description: Optional. Used to uniquely identity the resource. If passed in, the prompt uri is against this resourceId as a key.

uri.description: Path to the prompt that will be played. Currently supports only Wave file (.wav) format, single-channel, 16-bit samples with a 16,000 (16 KHz) sampling rate.

applicationFilter.description: Filter that defines the dynamic-application-syntax rule to include/exclude cloud applications. A filter can use custom security attributes to include/exclude applications.

excludeApplications.description: Can be one of the following:  The list of client IDs (appId) explicitly excluded from the policy. Office365 - For the list of apps included in Office365, see Apps included in Conditional Access Office 365 app suite  MicrosoftAdminPortals - For more information, see Conditional Access Target resources: Microsoft Admin Portals

includeApplications.description: Can be one of the following:  The list of client IDs (appId) the policy applies to, unless explicitly excluded (in excludeApplications)  All  Office365 - For the list of apps included in Office365, see Apps included in Conditional Access Office 365 app suite  MicrosoftAdminPortals - For more information, see Conditional Access Target resources: Microsoft Admin Portals

includeUserActions.description: User actions to include. Supported values are urn:user:registersecurityinfo and urn:user:registerdevice

excludeServicePrincipals.description: Service principal IDs excluded from the policy scope.

includeServicePrincipals.description: Service principal IDs included in the policy scope, or ServicePrincipalsInMyTenant.

servicePrincipalFilter.description: Filter that defines the dynamic-servicePrincipal-syntax rule to include/exclude service principals. A filter can use custom security attributes to include/exclude service principals.

deviceFilter.description: Filter that defines the dynamic-device-syntax rule to include/exclude devices. A filter can use device properties (such as extension attributes) to include/exclude them.

excludeLocations.description: Location IDs excluded from scope of policy.

includeLocations.description: Location IDs in scope of policy unless explicitly excluded, All, or AllTrusted.

excludePlatforms.description: The possible values are: android, iOS, windows, windowsPhone, macOS, linux, all, unknownFutureValue.

includePlatforms.description: The possible values are: android, iOS, windows, windowsPhone, macOS, linux, all, unknownFutureValue.

excludeGroups.description: Group IDs excluded from scope of policy.

excludeGuestsOrExternalUsers.description: Internal guests or external users excluded from the policy scope. Optionally populated.

excludeRoles.description: Role IDs excluded from scope of policy.
